d:
Maharashtr ki gokul deyri ke chunav men kangres-samarthit painal ne 25 men se 13 siten jitin, lekin rajy sarkar ke adhyadesh ke bad namit nideshkon ko matdan ka adhikar milne se satta ka samikran badal gaya. aakhir kaise palta chunavi janadesh aur sahkari sansthaon men sarkari dakhal par kyon uth rahe hain saval?
Thank you for watching our video!
